title: Aftershocks — what to expect and do
scenario: Ground keeps shaking again after the main earthquake. Repeated tremors, aftershock safety.
steps: Expect aftershocks for days to weeks after a major quake. Most are smaller, but some can cause new damage.
Each time shaking starts: Drop, Cover, and Hold On. Get under a sturdy table, cover your head and neck, hold on until it stops.
Stay away from damaged buildings, chimneys, windows, and anything that could fall.
If you are inside a sound building, stay inside during shaking — do not run out mid-shake.
Keep sturdy shoes and a flashlight by your bed.
Agree on a family meeting point in case an aftershock separates you.
do_not: Do not re-enter damaged buildings between aftershocks.
Do not stand near brick walls, chimneys, or glass.
